Clear bulletin for busy families
It is easier with this note
Travelers with pets need to check in early, keep carriers closed, and follow the desk team's handoff steps without delay.

Pet travel alert for Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is watching for tight boarding changes, kennel space, and any health review needs. Please keep collars snug, paperwork ready, and water access steady before you arrive. <<FACT F025>> If your route needs a transfer, stay with the animal at every handoff and tell the front desk right away about any stress, injury, or crate issue.

We also need every family to keep the travel bag simple and tidy. Clean bedding, secure latches, and clear labels help the staff move faster and reduce confusion at the gate. <<FACT F008>> If a pet shows signs of overheating, panic, or trouble breathing, step aside and alert a staff member at once so the review can start without delay.

Please come straight to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for the next steps and the latest boarding help.
